title: Odoo Developer
summary: Builds and customises modules for Odoo, an open-source ERP (software that runs accounting, sales, inventory and manufacturing), in Python with PostgreSQL. Works at an Odoo partner or in a company's IT team, next to functional consultants who set up the standard apps.
dailyDuties: Build or extend Odoo modules with models, views and access rules
Design QWeb reports such as invoices and delivery slips
Write Python business logic for client-specific processes
Integrate Odoo with other systems through XML-RPC or REST APIs
Upgrade custom modules to a newer Odoo version
Review issues with functional consultants and fix bugs

skills.expectation: Build and extend Odoo modules with the ORM, XML views, access rights and QWeb reports
Write Python business logic, computed fields and server actions
Write and tune PostgreSQL queries behind Odoo
Understand and configure standard Odoo apps such as Accounting, Sales, Inventory and Manufacturing
Change the Odoo web client with JavaScript and OWL components
Integrate Odoo with other systems through XML-RPC, JSON-RPC or REST APIs
Keep module code in Git and work through pull requests
Upgrade databases and custom modules between Odoo versions
Deploy and run Odoo on Linux servers
Run Odoo and PostgreSQL in containers
Turn client needs into a list of module changes
Know basic accounting and GST so accounting customisations are correct

certifications.why: Shows core Python skill for freshers moving into Odoo work
